description: WordBinary Self Plagiarism Checker opens an interactive widget where users can paste two documents and identify repeated phrase combinations. It highlights matching phrases of four or more consecutive words, shows a similarity percentage, and lists matched phrase combinations for quick writing review. Pasted text is processed inside the widget UI and is not stored by the MCP server.
